checks.check: Asset row = sum of its invoice rows (S8-R13) and (n) = invoice count
Customer row = sum of its asset rows (S8-R13) and (n) = its invoices (S7-R3)
Assets A-Z by label, "Parts Sales" bucket last (S8-R6, S8-R6a)

Invoice date on the row = invoice created date
Labor Invoiced = labor on the invoice lines (+ labor-line fees/discounts)
Parts Invoiced = parts on the invoice lines (+ part-line fees/discounts)

Subtotal = invoice pre-tax total (after invoice-level fees/discounts)
Adjustments = invoice-level fees minus discounts (S7-R17)
